SELECT SQLFLOW.SEQ_RESULT_ACCESS_LOG.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SQLFLOW.RESULT_ACCESS_LOG ( LOG_ID, REQUEST_ID, RESULT_ID, USER_ID, ACTION_TYPE, ACCESS_RESULT, ACCESSED_AT ) VALUES ( #{logId}, #{requestId}, #{resultId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId}, #{actionType}, #{accessResult}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, F.RESULT_ID, ACTOR.USER_ID FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = I.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.BATCH_ID = E.BATCH_ID AND B.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID JOIN USERS ACTOR ON ACTOR.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RESULT_ID, EXECUTION_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY EXECUTION_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, RESULT_ID DESC ) AS RESULT_RANK FROM QUERY_RESULT ) F ON F.EXECUTION_ID = E.EXECUTION_ID AND F.RESULT_RANK = 1 WHERE E.EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND ( E.BATCH_ID IS NULL OR B.BATCH_ID IS NOT NULL )
